fields.text:
Shareable demo: place + vibe → GLM 5.3 Flash writes a 3:2 film-stock postcard prompt → Muse Image.
Edit the place, pick a vibe, hit Run. No uploads. Cheap models (1x GLM Flash + Muse Image at 3:2).
Raohe night market, Taipei — grilled squid smoke, red lanterns, wet asphalt

fields.selected: humid neon, crowded, reflections in puddles

fields.system: You write one image prompt for a cinematic travel postcard in a 3:2 landscape frame, shot like analog film stock (fine grain, soft highlight roll-off, slightly lifted blacks). Combine the place and the vibe into a single vivid prompt: camera (35-50mm street), lighting, materials, weather, time of day, one human figure at most (no readable signage, no logos). Wide stall-row composition with breathing room on the left/right thirds; subject sits slightly off-center. Not square. 80-140 words. Reply with the prompt only.
